description: MCP-style local tool registry. Tools are declared here; the registry only dispatches calls for tools listed in this manifest, enforces their scope, and refuses disallowed tools.

tools.description: Return the synthetic profile for a user id (e.g. u001) from data/sample_users.json.
tools.name: get_user_profile

tools.description: Keyword search over the synthetic documents in data/sample_docs/. Returns matching snippets with source file names.
tools.name: search_docs

tools.description: List synthetic support tickets from data/sample_tickets.json. Optionally filter by status (open, in_progress, resolved).
tools.name: list_tickets

status.description: Optional status filter: open, in_progress, or resolved

tools.description: Append a note to data/notes.json. A write tool: requires explicit approval before it runs.
tools.name: create_note

text.description: Text of the note to append

tools.description: Delete a user. DISALLOWED: this tool is declared in the manifest only to demonstrate guardrails. It is disabled and the registry always refuses to execute it.
tools.name: delete_user
